text:
ashley: heads up — platform is landing a routing_policy hint on incoming requests. planning to expose it in the SDKs next week. question: do we make it a breaking change (new required arg) or add as optional?

ashley: main reason is we need clients to pass /prefer_cost or /prefer_latency so smart-routing can pick cheaper GPUs or local region variants. without it we fallback to default and cost SLOs suffer.

tariq: prefer optional. we can add a header mapper on the gateway that accepts either X-Route-Policy or the SDK param. keep server-side default if absent.

emma: agree optional first. but we should emit a deprecation-wire (warning log + telemetry tag) before making it required. dev-ex needs a clear upgrade path doc and code samples.

sam: from infra POV we also need to surface which routes actually obey policy vs ignored (some legacy endpoints bypass routing). telemetry events should include route_resolution: [selected_variant, fallback_used:true|false, reason]. that lets product show why cost didn't improve.

ashley: ok — plan: SDKs will add param routing_policy: Optional[str] and if omitted we don't include header. we'll add a warning log in v1.7, then make it required in v2.0. Emma can we craft the deprecation message?

emma: yes — propose message: "Redwood SDK: routing_policy will become required in v2.0. Pass routing_policy='prefer_cost' or 'prefer_latency' to control smart routing. See docs: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/routing"

emma: python snippet for the doc:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.generate("Summarize this...", routing_policy='prefer_cost')
```

emma: TS snippet too:

```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const r = await client.text.generate({ prompt: '...', routingPolicy: 'prefer_latency' })
```

sam: tests: add an e2e that verifies gateway sees header "x-routing-policy" and emits telemetry. also need unit test where policy is null -> no header.

ashley: consoles/UX ask: we should add a toggle on route creation (Console > Routes) with options: default / prefer_cost / prefer_latency / custom. and show per-route estimated cost delta based on past traffic. can product mock that?

tariq: product can show an estimate using historical token counts and model variant costs. we already have model unit costs in pricing service. frontend will call telemetry API for recent usage to compute delta.

emma: small gotcha: quotas. if a customer sets prefer_cost and that routes to a cheaper shared pool with quota, we need to surface quota hits differently. propose header on 429 responses: X-Quota-Bucket: <bucket-id> plus structured body {"quota_bucket":"<id>","limit":100000,"used":100001}. console can show which route is hitting which quota.

sam: yep that's required. infra will add header and structured body. also add metric `quota_denied_by_route` with tags route_id, policy.

deploy-bot: deploy started for feature/route-policy-sdk at 1742100320 by sam — build 9872

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded — canary on eng-dedicated-1 (3/3 instances passing)

ashley: thanks. next steps: Emma draft deprecation doc + migration guide; Sam add tests + e2e; Tariq update gateway header mapper; I'll schedule a quick sync with product to wire console toggle and estimates.

emma: will post PR with docs + example notebooks today.

sam: I'll attach a small test harness for the gateway to verify headers and quota headers in CI.

ashley: leaving here — ping me if anyone hits blockers. :thumbsup:
